578.name: Duosion
578.flavor_text: Its brain has split into two, and the two halves rarely think alike. Its actions are utterly unpredictable.

579.name: Reuniclus
579.flavor_text: It’s said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.

580.name: Ducklett
580.flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

581.name: Swanna
581.flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

582.name: Vanillite
582.flavor_text: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.

583.name: Vanillish
583.flavor_text: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it’s a kind Pokémon.

584.name: Vanilluxe
584.flavor_text: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.

585.name: Deerling
585.flavor_text: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

586.name: Sawsbuck
586.flavor_text: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.

587.name: Emolga
587.flavor_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

588.name: Karrablast
588.flavor_text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

589.name: Escavalier
589.flavor_text: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch’d.

590.name: Foongus
590.flavor_text: The spores released from this Pokémon’s hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.

591.name: Amoonguss
591.flavor_text: Amoonguss generally doesn’t move much. It tends to stand still near Poké Balls that have been dropped on the ground.

592.name: Frillish Male
592.flavor_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

593.name: Jellicent Male
593.flavor_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

594.name: Alomomola
594.flavor_text: The reason it helps Pokémon in a weakened condition is that any Pokémon coming after them may also attack Alomomola.

595.name: Joltik
595.flavor_text: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They’re often found sticking to Yamper’s hindquarters.

596.name: Galvantula
596.flavor_text: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.

597.name: Ferroseed
597.flavor_text: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed’s spikes grow big and strong.

598.name: Ferrothorn
598.flavor_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

599.name: Klink
599.flavor_text: It’s suspected that Klink were the inspiration behind ancient people’s invention of the first gears.

600.name: Klang
600.flavor_text: Many companies in the Galar region choose Klang as their logo. This Pokémon is considered the symbol of industrial technology.

601.name: Klinklang
601.flavor_text: The three gears that compose this Pokémon spin at high speed. Its new spiked gear isn’t a living creature.

602.name: Tynamo
602.flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

603.name: Eelektrik
603.flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

604.name: Eelektross
604.flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

605.name: Elgyem
605.flavor_text: This Pokémon was discovered about 50 years ago. Its highly developed brain enables it to exert its psychic powers.

606.name: Beheeyem
606.flavor_text: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.

607.name: Litwick
607.flavor_text: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

608.name: Lampent
608.flavor_text: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

609.name: Chandelure
609.flavor_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

610.name: Axew
610.flavor_text: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn’t a concern.

611.name: Fraxure
611.flavor_text: Its skin is as hard as a suit of armor. Fraxure’s favorite strategy is to tackle its opponents, stabbing them with its tusks at the same time.

612.name: Haxorus
612.flavor_text: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.

613.name: Cubchoo
613.flavor_text: It sniffles before performing a move, using its frosty snot to provide an icy element to any move that needs it.

614.name: Beartic
614.flavor_text: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.

615.name: Cryogonal
615.flavor_text: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.

616.name: Shelmet
616.flavor_text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

617.name: Accelgor
617.flavor_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

618.name: Stunfisk
618.flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.

619.name: Mienfoo
619.flavor_text: Though small, Mienfoo’s temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.

620.name: Mienshao
620.flavor_text: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.

621.name: Druddigon
621.flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

622.name: Golett
622.flavor_text: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

623.name: Golurk
623.flavor_text: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

624.name: Pawniard
624.flavor_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

625.name: Bisharp
625.flavor_text: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

626.name: Bouffalant
626.flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.

627.name: Rufflet
627.flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

628.name: Braviary
628.flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

629.name: Vullaby
629.flavor_text: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.

630.name: Mandibuzz
630.flavor_text: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.

631.name: Heatmor
631.flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

632.name: Durant
632.flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

633.name: Deino
633.flavor_text: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

634.name: Zweilous
634.flavor_text: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

635.name: Hydreigon
635.flavor_text: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

636.name: Larvesta
636.flavor_text: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.

637.name: Volcarona
637.flavor_text: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.

638.name: Cobalion
638.flavor_text: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.

639.name: Terrakion
639.flavor_text: In Unovan legend, Terrakion battled against humans in an effort to protect other Pokémon.

640.name: Virizion
640.flavor_text: It darts around opponents with a flurry of quick movements, slicing them up with its horns.

641.name: Tornadus Incarnate
641.flavor_text: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

642.name: Thundurus Incarnate
642.flavor_text: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

643.name: Reshiram
643.flavor_text: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

644.name: Zekrom
644.flavor_text: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

645.name: Landorus Incarnate
645.flavor_text: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

646.name: Kyurem
646.flavor_text: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

647.name: Keldeo Ordinary
647.flavor_text: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.

648.name: Meloetta Aria
648.flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

649.name: Genesect
649.flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

650.name: Chespin
650.flavor_text: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

651.name: Quilladin
651.flavor_text: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

652.name: Chesnaught
652.flavor_text: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

653.name: Fennekin
653.flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

654.name: Braixen
654.flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

655.name: Delphox
655.flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

656.name: Froakie
656.flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

657.name: Frogadier
657.flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

658.name: Greninja
658.flavor_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

659.name: Bunnelby
659.flavor_text: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

660.name: Diggersby
660.flavor_text: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

661.name: Fletchling
661.flavor_text: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

662.name: Fletchinder
662.flavor_text: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

663.name: Talonflame
663.flavor_text: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

664.name: Scatterbug
664.flavor_text: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

665.name: Spewpa
665.flavor_text: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

666.name: Vivillon
666.flavor_text: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

667.name: Litleo
667.flavor_text: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

668.name: Pyroar Male
668.flavor_text: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn’t use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

669.name: Flabebe
669.flavor_text: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

670.name: Floette
670.flavor_text: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

671.name: Florges
671.flavor_text: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

672.name: Skiddo
672.flavor_text: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

673.name: Gogoat
673.flavor_text: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

674.name: Pancham
674.flavor_text: Wanting to make sure it’s taken seriously, Pancham’s always giving others a glare. But if it’s not focusing, it ends up smiling.

675.name: Pangoro
675.flavor_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

676.name: Furfrou
676.flavor_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

677.name: Espurr
677.flavor_text: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

678.name: Meowstic Male
678.flavor_text: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

679.name: Honedge
679.flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword’s handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people’s lives away.

680.name: Doublade
680.flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

681.name: Aegislash Shield
681.flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

682.name: Spritzee
682.flavor_text: The scent its body gives off enraptures those who smell it. Noble ladies had no shortage of love for Spritzee.

683.name: Aromatisse
683.flavor_text: The scents Aromatisse can produce range from sweet smells that bolster allies to foul smells that sap an opponent’s will to fight.

684.name: Swirlix
684.flavor_text: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix’s fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.

685.name: Slurpuff
685.flavor_text: Slurpuff’s fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.

686.name: Inkay
686.flavor_text: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

687.name: Malamar
687.flavor_text: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

688.name: Binacle
688.flavor_text: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

689.name: Barbaracle
689.flavor_text: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

690.name: Skrelp
690.flavor_text: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

691.name: Dragalge
691.flavor_text: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

692.name: Clauncher
692.flavor_text: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

693.name: Clawitzer
693.flavor_text: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

694.name: Helioptile
694.flavor_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

695.name: Heliolisk
695.flavor_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

696.name: Tyrunt
696.flavor_text: This Pokémon is selfish and likes to be pampered. It can also inflict grievous wounds on its Trainer just by playing around.

697.name: Tyrantrum
697.flavor_text: A single bite of Tyrantrum’s massive jaws will demolish a car. This Pokémon was the king of the ancient world.

698.name: Amaura
698.flavor_text: Amaura is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. Specimens of this species can sometimes be found frozen in ice.

699.name: Aurorus
699.flavor_text: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

700.name: Sylveon
700.flavor_text: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

701.name: Hawlucha
701.flavor_text: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.

702.name: Dedenne
702.flavor_text: Since Dedenne can’t generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

703.name: Carbink
703.flavor_text: It’s said that somewhere in the world, there’s a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It’s also said that this pack has a queen.

704.name: Goomy
704.flavor_text: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

705.name: Sliggoo
705.flavor_text: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

706.name: Goodra
706.flavor_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

707.name: Klefki
707.flavor_text: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.

708.name: Phantump
708.flavor_text: With a voice like a human child’s, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

709.name: Trevenant
709.flavor_text: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon’s feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

710.name: Pumpkaboo Average
710.flavor_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

711.name: Gourgeist Average
711.flavor_text: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

712.name: Bergmite
712.flavor_text: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

713.name: Avalugg
713.flavor_text: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

714.name: Noibat
714.flavor_text: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

715.name: Noivern
715.flavor_text: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

716.name: Xerneas
716.flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

717.name: Yveltal
717.flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

718.name: Zygarde 50
718.flavor_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

719.name: Diancie
719.flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

720.name: Hoopa
720.flavor_text: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

721.name: Volcanion
721.flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

722.name: Rowlet
722.flavor_text: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

723.name: Dartrix
723.flavor_text: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

724.name: Decidueye
724.flavor_text: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

725.name: Litten
725.flavor_text: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

726.name: Torracat
726.flavor_text: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

727.name: Incineroar
727.flavor_text: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

728.name: Popplio
728.flavor_text: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

729.name: Brionne
729.flavor_text: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

730.name: Primarina
730.flavor_text: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

731.name: Pikipek
731.flavor_text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

732.name: Trumbeak
732.flavor_text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

733.name: Toucannon
733.flavor_text: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

734.name: Yungoos
734.flavor_text: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.

735.name: Gumshoos
735.flavor_text: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!

736.name: Grubbin
736.flavor_text: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.

737.name: Charjabug
737.flavor_text: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

738.name: Vikavolt
738.flavor_text: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.

739.name: Crabrawler
739.flavor_text: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.

740.name: Crabominable
740.flavor_text: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.

741.name: Oricorio Baile
741.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

742.name: Cutiefly
742.flavor_text: An opponent’s aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent’s next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

743.name: Ribombee
743.flavor_text: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

744.name: Rockruff
744.flavor_text: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

745.name: Lycanroc Midday
745.flavor_text: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

746.name: Wishiwashi Solo
746.flavor_text: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

747.name: Mareanie
747.flavor_text: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

748.name: Toxapex
748.flavor_text: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

749.name: Mudbray
749.flavor_text: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.

750.name: Mudsdale
750.flavor_text: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.

751.name: Dewpider
751.flavor_text: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.

752.name: Araquanid
752.flavor_text: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.

753.name: Fomantis
753.flavor_text: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.

754.name: Lurantis
754.flavor_text: The petals on this Pokémon’s arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.

755.name: Morelull
755.flavor_text: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.

756.name: Shiinotic
756.flavor_text: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don’t go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.

757.name: Salandit
757.flavor_text: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

758.name: Salazzle
758.flavor_text: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

759.name: Stufful
759.flavor_text: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.

760.name: Bewear
760.flavor_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

761.name: Bounsweet
761.flavor_text: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

762.name: Steenee
762.flavor_text: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

763.name: Tsareena
763.flavor_text: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

764.name: Comfey
764.flavor_text: These Pokémon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokémon has its own individual scent.

765.name: Oranguru
765.flavor_text: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

766.name: Passimian
766.flavor_text: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

767.name: Wimpod
767.flavor_text: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

768.name: Golisopod
768.flavor_text: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

769.name: Sandygast
769.flavor_text: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.

770.name: Palossand
770.flavor_text: This Pokémon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can’t maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.

771.name: Pyukumuku
771.flavor_text: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

772.name: Type Null
772.flavor_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

773.name: Silvally
773.flavor_text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
